registryBasis: Kancheepuram District's official Survey & Land Records office page identifies the district custodian and documents digitized Natham and urban land records, digitized Field Measurement sketches, online land-record management, and village-map mosaicing. The district's official land-services page links the Tamil Nadu e-Services land-record workflow for Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR and A-Register extracts. This establishes local/state registry custody, but not a verified open parcel-vector response.
